I can do that — but deleting email is destructive, so I need a quick confirmation of exactly what you want. Please review and reply with your choice.

Proposed match (what I would remove)
- Location: Inbox only
- Senders/keyword: messages from Atlassian (any address containing "atlassian")
- Date range: all of 2023 (from 2023-01-01 through 2023-12-31)

Gmail search I’ll use to identify them (you can copy/paste to check first):
in:inbox (from:atlassian.com OR from:@atlassian.com) after:2022/12/31 before:2024/01/01

Action options — reply with one exact option:
1) Delete (move all matched messages to Trash) — I will run the deletion immediately. Note: Trash is typically purged automatically after ~30 days.  
2) Archive (remove from Inbox but keep in All Mail) — safer if you might need them later.  
3) Apply label "Old Atlassian 2023" and leave in Inbox (so you can review) — non-destructive.  
4) Custom — tell me a different sender pattern, date range, or include All Mail/other folders.

Which do you want? If you pick 1, confirm by replying: "Yes — delete all Inbox Atlassian messages from 2023" and I will proceed.
